description: This file defines classes and methods for MLlib tree-based algorithms in Spark, including models for gradient boosted trees, random forests, and decision trees, along with their summaries, predictions, and save/load functionalities.

classes.name: GBTRegressionModel
classes.description: Represents a Gradient Boosted Tree Regression Model backed by a Java Scala object.

classes.name: GBTClassificationModel
classes.description: Represents a Gradient Boosted Tree Classification Model backed by a Java Scala object.

classes.name: RandomForestRegressionModel
classes.description: Represents a Random Forest Regression Model backed by a Java Scala object.

classes.name: RandomForestClassificationModel
classes.description: Represents a Random Forest Classification Model backed by a Java Scala object.

classes.name: DecisionTreeRegressionModel
classes.description: Represents a Decision Tree Regression Model backed by a Java Scala object.

classes.name: DecisionTreeClassificationModel
classes.description: Represents a Decision Tree Classification Model backed by a Java Scala object.
